This is the rise and fall of crypto queen Zhimin Qian. After taking money from more than 120,000 people, she flees China and lives in luxury across Europe - until one small mistake brings everything crashing down.

Our reconstruction of Zhimin Qian’s biography is largely based on a detailed profile published by the Chinese magazine China Newsweek.
